2609.02371.title: Diagnosing with Insights: Structured Analysis of Agent Failures via Behavioral Abstractions
2609.02371.paper_summary: With the proliferation of LLM agents, the ability to understand and diagnose failures in agents is essential to achieving superior effectiveness and trustworthiness. As agent failures often manifest via long and complex trajectories, manually finding the needles in the haystack is untenable. However, traditional diagnosis techniques for software bugs can hardly address LLM agent failures, while completely relying on LLMs as the judge yields unreliable diagnosis results. To overcome these challenges, this paper presents AGENTSCOPE, a new neuro-symbolic approach for agent failure mode diagnosis. The key principle of AGENTSCOPE is to abstract agent behavior, based on its trajectories, into structured representations. Furthermore, AGENTSCOPE introduces the concept of neural invariants to specify agent behavior properties. AGENTSCOPE leverages LLM-guided reasoning atop the structured representation against neural invariants to pinpoint both the failure step and its type in the trajectory. We show the effectiveness of AGENTSCOPE on publicly available agent failure datasets (Who&When) and a more comprehensive dataset created by us (AgentErrata), where AGENTSCOPE significantly outperforms the current state of the art in fault localization and attribution accuracy. Our work shows that integrating structured abstractions with LLM-guided reasoning enables effective, reliable, and interpretable diagnosis for agent failures.
2609.02371.paper_summary_zh: 隨著 LLM 代理的普及，理解和診斷代理失敗的能力對於實現卓越的效率和可信度至關重要。由於代理失敗通常通過冗長而複雜的軌跡表現出來，手動在堆中尋找針是不切實際的。然而，傳統的軟體錯誤診斷技術幾乎無法解決 LLM 代理的失敗，而完全依賴 LLM 作為判斷者則會產生不可靠的診斷結果。為了克服這些挑戰，本文提出了 AGENTSCOPE，一種新的神經符號方法來診斷代理失敗模式。AGENTSCOPE 的關鍵原則是基於代理的軌跡將其行為抽象為結構化表示。此外，AGENTSCOPE 引入了神經不變性的概念來指定代理行為屬性。AGENTSCOPE 利用基於結構化表示的 LLM 引導推理，針對神經不變性來精確定位軌跡中的失敗步驟及其類型。我們在公開可用的代理失敗數據集（Who&When）和我們創建的更全面的數據集（AgentErrata）上展示了 AGENTSCOPE 的有效性，AGENTSCOPE 在故障定位和歸因準確性方面顯著超越了當前的最先進技術。我們的工作表明，將結構化抽象與 LLM 引導推理相結合，可以實現對代理失敗的有效、可靠和可解釋的診斷。
